title: The Incomprehensibility of the Father
english: The Word enters into the inscriptions of the ascents [Psalms 120-134].
But the Father, being perfect, infinite, and unsearchable, not in need of glory or of any kind of elegance, does not accept acquired glory; nor even the Word [...]
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: The Creator and the Exalted Christ
english: Him, being God having been born from himself, through whom angels and heavens and the unbounded magnitudes of the earth and all the created matters and compositions collectively have come into being. But the man Christ, being raised from the dead, is exalted and glorified, of the [...]

title: The scattering of the envious
english: Shame [is] set against them, opposing them. Those who are set in hatred by envy and are blocked by war will be put in order and scattered, because the Word and God has worthily raised up his own temple.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
